categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and adds the `staletip` P2P message protocol, peer negotiation, and anti-DoS rules.
categories.rationale: Implements the BIP 332 stale tip relay protocol to give node operators and monitoring tools visibility into network splits and orphan rates. Protocol changes with a formal specification that introduce new wire messages and adjust DoS peer punishment rules represent substantial, strategically important P2P work.
